annotations.title: Check an EU EORI customs number (paid)

description: Use when you need to check an EU EORI customs number: live validation in the European Commission's EORI service, registered and valid or not, with the trader's name and address when published. All EU member states; GB numbers are not covered. Costs 0.003 USDC via x402, or 2 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.
